title: Ruth Alison Clemens
text:
Cultural theorist, educator, writer, and researcher with a background in literary analysis and groundbreaking historical research.

Research Interests

Critical perspectives on the materiality of language
Transnationalism, multilingualism, and book history
The intersection of music, technology, and literature
Modernism and the avant-garde
I also work as a literary translator from Dutch to English (Clemens 2018)

Check out my guest appearance on Sounds Like Tufa, Radio Worm, 13 January 2026
